name: @cookielab.io/klovi
description: Klovi — browse and present AI coding session history
author: Cookielab s.r.o.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run build:entrypoints && bun run build:shebang && bun run build:web-assets && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.build:entrypoints: bun build src/cli.ts src/server.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external effect --external @effect/platform --external @effect/platform-bun --external @effect/platform-node
scripts.build:shebang: printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' | cat - dist/cli.js > dist/cli.tmp && mv dist/cli.tmp dist/cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'ERROR: Do not publish from apps/package source. Publish from apps/package/.stage/npm instead. Run: bun run stage:npm' && exit 1
